blocks.text: LAS VEGAS — There was a chance for a short time that the Las Vegas Grand Prix could be the final Formula 1 race of the season. Adding a stop in Italy also was considered. But in the end, F1 officials decided to stay with the original schedule of finishing the season in Qatar and Abu Dhabi even with tensions in the Middle East heightened by the conflict between the United States and Iran.
